name: Singing Clockwork Garden
description: A whimsical garden where mechanical flowers bloom in synchronized patterns, each petal rotating and emitting melodic tones as the gentle breeze passes through.
prompt: A vivid garden of brass and copper clockwork flowers, gears visible, petals turning in harmony, soft breezes causing them to whirr and produce gentle musical notes, warm golden sunlight, detailed textures, steampunk meets nature, no text, peaceful yet magical ambience.
caption: Watch the flowers dance and sing—nature reimagined with the heart of a thousand tiny clocks.
